evidence.source: Operator's live sandbox POST https://api.commerce7.com/v1/coupon through the public API (App ID / App Secret Basic Auth). Every request below returned HTTP 201.
observed: For the percentage coupon, the provider echoed dollarOffDiscountApplies = "Once Per Order" although the field was not sent.

2026-10-08: a coupon created with discount 15 was shown as 0.15% in Commerce7 Admin and took CAD 0.03 off CAD 18.97 at checkout. HTTP 201 did not prove percentage semantics; the native unit is 1/100 of a percent (live-coupon-percentage-observation.json).
evidence.notSupplied: Only the request payloads, status and the observation above were supplied. The 201 response bodies were not, so no response body is stored here; readback tests that need one build a synthetic echo and say so. startDate/endDate values were elided in the evidence; code and title were sent but not shown.
evidence.credentials: None. No Authorization header, JWT, tenant secret or cookie is stored.

minimumSubtotal.cartRequirement: integer minor units (the probe's value was not supplied)
